{npc:Rafzan}, a "poor and honest" goblin merchant in the Venore swamp, needs help with 6 small tasks: spreading advertising, making perfume for the ratmen, "recruiting" guards, annoying and sabotaging the ratmen and killing Marsh Stalkers. Each task gives experience and gold (5200 exp and 1100 gp in total) and can be repeated every 20 hours. After 500 tasks you get the achievement **Task Manager**.
Rafzan can always use a bit of extra help.
No minimum level; level 35 recommended (the tasks in the Corym caves are dangerous for low levels).
for the Perfume task; you can get it beforehand

Given by Rafzan (if you lose them, you have to buy them from him): 3 {item:Advertisement Sign|Advertisement Signs}, {item:Perfume Gatherer}, {item:Guardcatcher}, {item:Bottle with Rat Urine}, {item:Trunkhammer}.
5200 experience and 1100 gp per full round of the 6 tasks
Accept **all** the tasks at once: they can be done at the same time and you save a lot of trips.
The **destroy** and **busy** tasks both take you to the {wiki:Venore Corym Cave}: do both in the same trip.

The **guards**, **kill** and **advertising** tasks are done on the surface of the swamp. Instead of wandering aimlessly, also do the {wiki:Venore Daily Tasks Quest}: it gives you a route through the swamp and you will find enough targets along the way.

If you repeat this a lot, buy {item:Perfume Gatherer|Perfume Gatherers} from Rafzan and fill them all at once in the {creature:Slug|Slugs} cave (27–28 slugs with a full spawn). You only need to buy the initial stock: every time you accept the task you receive another empty one.
If you go to the northern construction site, consider digging for a {item:Leech} (once a week).

If you are not in **Venore**, take a boat and say {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the captain. Leave **Venore** by the east exit: you come down at {coord:33004,32095,6}. Leave the building and walk a few steps east until you find a staircase and/or ramp. This is the central construction site of the {wiki:Venore Daily Tasks Quest}.
Go down here (east exit of Venore)
Go to the **northeast** platform of the construction site and go down the stairs. Walk **east** until you see a fancy building.

On the **south** side of the building there is an elevator. If the elevator is up, use the {item:Pulley} to bring it down. Stand on the elevator and use the pulley to go up. To leave Rafzan's house, stand on the elevator again and use the {item:Pulley} to go down to the swamp. To return to Venore, take the route in reverse to the east exit ({coord:33004,32095,6}).

Talk to {npc:Rafzan}: {key:hi}, {key:help} (or {key:tasks}), {key:get} and then the task word ({key:advertising}, {key:perfume}, {key:guards}, {key:busy}, {key:destroy}, {key:kill}). Answer {key:yes} to each one. To hand in, say {key:report} and the task word. After a while you do not even need to say help/tasks/get/report: the task word is enough.
Each task can be repeated every **20 hours**.
Say {key:advertising} and {key:yes} to {npc:Rafzan}. You receive 3 {item:Advertisement Sign|Advertisement Signs}.
Use the posters on {item:Cracked Stone|Cracked Stones} scattered around the swamp. Each stone can only be used once in a certain period of time. There are three near Rafzan.
An Advertisement Sign placed on a Cracked Stone
Go back to {npc:Rafzan} and say {key:report} and {key:advertising}.
You need to collect 4 smells in the {item:Perfume Gatherer}, **in this order**.
Say {key:perfume} and {key:yes} to {npc:Rafzan}. You receive the {item:Perfume Gatherer}.

Go to the Venore **Slug Cave**. Kill a {creature:Slug}, wait **10 seconds** and use the {item:Perfume Gatherer} on the corpse. The message *"You gather the first part of the rat perfume!"* appears. Leave the cave the same way you came in.
Slug Cave: using the Perfume Gatherer on a Slug corpse
Look for {item:Black Swamp Gas} (it looks like smoke or grey {item:Poison Gas}) in the swamp and use the Perfume Gatherer on it. *"You gather the second part of the rat perfume!"* appears.
Black Swamp Gas in the swamp

Go to a cave with {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} and use the Perfume Gatherer on a **live** rotworm, repeatedly, until you catch the fart. If it fails: *"Darn! It didn't fart!"*. If you succeed: *"You gather the third part of the rat perfume!"*. On average it takes about 3.85 attempts; the rotworm does not disappear.
Catching the fart of a live Rotworm

Use the Perfume Gatherer on a {item:Mouldy Cheese}. You can get the cheese from the Venore {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls}, {creature:Goblin|Goblins} (rare), in the {wiki:Corym Caves} and in many other places (it respawns daily).
Example of using the Perfume Gatherer (4th smell)
When the Perfume Gatherer has the description *"It is filled with smelley goo."*, go back to {npc:Rafzan} and say {key:report} and {key:perfume}.
Say {key:guards} and {key:yes} to {npc:Rafzan}. You receive the {item:Guardcatcher} (it looks like a bow).

Look for {creature:Adventurer|Adventurers} around the swamp and use the Guardcatcher on at least **three**. Either the adventurer disappears (*"Arrrgh! Not my knee!"*), or an {creature:Angry Adventurer} is left behind (*"You fiend! I will get you, servant of evil!"*). When you hit the third one, the bow breaks with the message *"Luckily the makeshift bow breaks as you hit the last adventurer you needed and not earlier!"*.
Go back to {npc:Rafzan} and say {key:report} and {key:guards}.
Kill **5** {creature:Marsh Stalker|Marsh Stalkers} anywhere in the swamp.
Go back to {npc:Rafzan} and say {key:report} and {key:killing} (or {key:kill}).
Say {key:busy} and {key:yes} to {npc:Rafzan}. You receive the {item:Bottle with Rat Urine}.
Go to the {wiki:Venore Corym Cave}, northeast of Rafzan's building, entering through a house: go **up** the stairs inside the house and then **down** the ladders.
House with the Corym Cave entrance
Use the urine on the lake

Inside the cave go **east** and go down the hole. Then go far **east** to a lake. **Use** the bottle on the centre of the lake, from a distance (as if it were a fishing rod). *"The keen noses of the ratmen will smell the mark of their rivals!"* appears.

To leave, go back **west** to the hole and climb up with the {item:Rope}; then go up the ladders and down the house stairs ({coord:33072,32089,7}).
Use the Bottle with Rat Urine in the middle of the lake
The ratmen (Corym) are dangerous: the cave is not recommended below level 35. Do not go alone if you are inexperienced.
Go back to {npc:Rafzan} and say {key:report} and {key:busy}.
Say {key:destroy} and {key:yes} to {npc:Rafzan}. You receive the {item:Trunkhammer}.

In the {wiki:Venore Corym Cave} (entrance through the house northeast of Rafzan), look for {item:Junk Trunk|Junk Trunks} (they look like {item:Large Trunk|Large Trunks}) and use the {item:Trunkhammer} on **3** of them. They turn into {item:Smashed Trunk|Smashed Trunks}. At the end the hammer disappears. Enter as in the busy task (go up the stairs of the house and down the ladders) and leave the same way: use the {item:Rope} to climb the holes you went down, go up the ladders and down the house stairs.
House with the Corym Cave entrance
A Junk Trunk in the Corym Cave
It is one of the hardest tasks, because you have to explore the caves. Do it together with the busy task.
Go back to {npc:Rafzan} and say {key:report} and {key:destroyed} (or {key:destroy}).
If you lose one of the task items before finishing the task, you have to buy another from Rafzan.
You can repeat each task every 20 hours. The **Task Manager** achievement comes after 500 tasks handed in.
